scope: Private managed-account source, exact-account adapter and signed shadow intake for YCloud/Kapso; legacy unchanged

implementation.source: Service-only INVOKER RPC, empty search_path; exact workspace/connection/provider; legacy sources excluded, revoked or expired credentials unavailable; AES-GCM owner binding and key-version validation
implementation.revision: Internal MD5 concurrency token over source identity/status/revision/ciphertext/key-version/expiry. Not an authentication credential and never returned by HTTP
implementation.transaction: Connection and credential SHARE locks survive until delivery transaction commits; current revision rechecked before any write
implementation.adapter: Ready managed connection uses its own API key and sender ID; no fallback to current workspace integration. Legacy path retained. Does not grant permission or enable a connection
implementation.rollout: CHANNEL_ACCOUNT_INGRESS_CONNECTIONS: explicit connection UUIDs only; empty off, independent of previous workspace flags
implementation.authentication: Raw YCloud HMAC plus timestamp window, or raw Kapso HMAC; source resolved from route scope, never body IDs; exact destination checked by normalization
implementation.capture: Signed normalized messages -> inbound_events; signed status -> private.channel_delivery_receipts and exact-account reconciliation. No contacts/conversations/materialized messages/buffer/model/new outbound jobs
implementation.dedup: Per workspace/connection/provider event ID; receive-time differences allowed; content/status collisions rejected transactionally
implementation.acknowledgement: Only normalized storage success is recorded:true; shadowOnly:true. Disabled/storage failure503, wrong signature/source401, invalid delivery400, streaming body above1MiB413
implementation.notOperational: Shadow capture is not inbox materialization or a connected production account. No provider webhook was configured to this URL

tests.lint: pass for all changed TypeScript production/tests
tests.cloudProbe: PostgreSQL17.11 same probe local/Cloud: source, dedup, collision, rotation invalidation, receipt, revoke and ACL; rolled back
tests.http: 22 checks through actual Next3100 -> PostgREST -> SQL against two synthetic accounts, plus endpoint-disabled checks before/after temporary QA flag
tests.transport: Three adapter sends fully intercepted by test fetch: two YCloud accounts and one Kapso; exact own key and sender asserted; zero provider network requests
tests.browser: No visual changes or browser operations in this increment; previous account form interactive/responsive review remains pending under recorded browser policy block
tests.build: Not repeated; full unit/DB suites, typecheck/lint, real SQL and HTTP used

autoBlindaje: HTTP fixture initially selected id from message_jobs, whose PK is operation_id. Check shared workspace_id for empty side-effect tables. Before retry, reconcile durable event and reuse its occurredAt; changing the timestamp under a fixed event ID is a collision, not a retry
